desc:
🐾 Welcome to Become a Pet!

Hatch pets, BECOME them, and build the best pet base!

🐣 Hatch eggs to find cute pets, then turn into your pet and play as it
🥚 Find eggs around the map and carry them home before time runs out
⚔️ Use your pet's attack to knock eggs away from other players and grab them
🌙 Rare Legendary and Mythical eggs come out every night
👑 Watch for super rare Secret and Eternal eggs. The whole server sees them spawn!
💰 Place pets in your base to earn cash, even while you're away
🍑 Feed your pets to level up and evolve them into new forms
🍀 Upgrade your luck to hatch rarer pets
🧚 Help your fairy friend with quests for rewards
🌦️ Weather can give your pets special mutations
📖 Fill your Index with every pet!

Which pet will you become?

🎮 Play on Desktop, Console, Mobile, and Tablet.
